notes: Initial SC TO-I offer to purchase up to 400,000 shares at a fixed $6.00 cash price. Estimated NAV was $9.84 at Dec 31 2020 and the filing states the price is 39 percent lower than NAV; price_pct_nav is left null because the percent needs arithmetic (about 61). fund_type reit is the filer's own description (a real estate investment trust; it describes a transition from BDC to REIT). The conditions set maps the Section 3 items: legal action to legal_injunction, banking moratorium to market_disruption, the Board-judgment material adverse effect item to board_discretion; the war and credit-limitation items are not separately coded. The price is fixed, so nav_pricing_date is null. No results in the excerpt. The offer expires April 19 2021 unless extended; no extension appears in the excerpt.
